facts.text: The clone supports only the DHO804 and DHO824 oscilloscopes (identical hardware)
The clone's supported firmware version is 00.01.04
The class RigolDHO824 manages communication with the Rigol DHO824 oscilloscope
The constructor creates pyvisa's ResourceManager
connect() opens self.resource_string with pyvisa's exclusive_lock access mode
A checked write sends the command with pyvisa's write and then queries ':SYSTem:ERRor?'
A checked query sends the command with pyvisa's query and then queries ':SYSTem:ERRor?'
get_identity() queries '*IDN?' when no identity is cached
The identity string has the format 'RIGOL TECHNOLOGIES,<model>,<serial>,<version>'
The DVM is enabled or disabled with ':DVM:ENABle ON' or ':DVM:ENABle OFF'
DVMMode defines the values ACRM (AC RMS), DC (DC average) and DCRM (AC+DC RMS)
The current DVM voltage is queried with ':DVM:CURRent?' and parsed as a float in volts
The channel configuration queries ':CHAN<n>:' display, coupling, probe, bandwidth limit, scale, offset and invert
The main timebase scale and offset are queried with ':TIM:MAIN:SCAL?' and ':TIM:MAIN:OFFS?'
A run, stop or single acquisition is requested with ':RUN', ':STOP' or ':SING', after which the trigger status is queried with ':TRIG:STAT?'
The trigger status query returns TD, WAIT, RUN, AUTO, or STOP
At a 1X probe ratio, the DHO800 series vertical scale ranges from 500 uV/div to 10 V/div
The probe ratio affects the value and settable range of the current vertical scale
The DHO800 series time base range is 5 ns/div to 500 s/div
The channel coupling values are AC, DC and GND
The programming guide lists discrete probe attenuation ratios from 0.001 to 50000
The bandwidth limit query returns 20M or OFF
Waveform capture selects WORD format and reads ':WAV:DATA?' with _query_binary_values_checked

operator_required.reason: The guide states 500 uV/div to 10 V/div only at a 1X probe ratio (manuals/DHO800900_ProgrammingGuide_EN.md:3854-3856); changing the probe ratio changes the scale range (line 3892). Supply deployment bounds valid for the configured channel and every permitted probe ratio.
